proof_summary: Separating the last summand gives the recurrence \(a(n+1)=2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}+(2^n-1)a(n)\); for odd prime \(p\), Fermat’s theorem and the shift formula for the triangular exponent show that both recurrence coefficients are unchanged modulo \(p\) after a shift of \(2(p-1)\), while the shifted initial value is congruent to \(a(1)\), so induction proves the result. For \(p=2\), the same recurrence shows directly that every \(a(n)\) with \(n\ge1\) is odd.
